scope: Targeted additional primary-source reading during serialized speech training; no change to the live experiment.

sources.finding: Moshi-based Japanese corpus study reports that data timing and domain affect generated turn-taking; more mixed data did not consistently improve coherence.
sources.application: Treat our additional overlap examples as a distribution change; inspect timing and content separately. Their task and much larger dataset differ from Jun.

sources.finding: NemotronLabs VoiceChat uses a9Bbackbone,600Mstreaming encoder and977Mspeech decoder/codec. It is not a smaller replacement for this Mac.
sources.application: No switch or download based on this paper.

sources.finding: BayLing-Duplex combines SFT with timing-only DPO negatives and retention SFT; it separately weights silence and role tokens.
sources.application: Potential future controlled timing preference pairs; not a drop-in Moshi recipe. No model conversion attempted.

sources.finding: Moshi EPAD precedes the next word after padding; it is not the same as a dialogue turn-end token.
sources.application: Our diagnostic separation of token0 from token3 matters. Do not copy BayLing turn-state weights by token name.

sources.finding: The pinned MLX NumPy conversion copies input buffers. A NumPy memmap does not make the model weights zero-copy GPU storage.
sources.application: Avoid claiming memory mapping solves full-resident inference.

sources.finding: The MLX file-object safetensor loader evaluates synchronously and reads directly into its own memory through readinto.
sources.application: A compact virtual file exposing only selected tensors can avoid constructing unused lazy tensors without copying weights to another disk file. Tiny native trace parity passed; real-model performance still being measured.

sources.finding: TASTE2-2B-EN is based on Qwen2-1.5B and explicitly is not dialogue-fine-tuned. It uses an incremental speech-tokenizer/spoken-LM/CosyVoice2 stack and a research-only license.
sources.application: Potential research alternative, not a ready smaller replacement for the trained Moshi duplex model. No download or switch.

local_observation: The run07adapter improves spoken-token CE but reduces EPAD top1accuracy on both validation clips versus base. Current training weights both PAD and EPAD by0.05.
next_hypothesis: After the declared run08 experiment, consider separately weighting EPAD and PAD, with an unchanged validation protocol and actual audio review. This is a hypothesis, not an established explanation for failure.
